title: Studio media models
question: What can the independent Media Studio generate today, read from its own catalogue and then checked model by model against the provider's current published route?

previousCheck.what: Composer's snapshot of the Studio manifest, refreshed after the Studio Draft retirement. It listed the eight Composer-selectable models and one retired record.

entries.label: Studio catalogue manifest
entries.observed: HTTP 200, 20,890 bytes. contract media-studio-capabilities v1, checkedAt and lastGoodAt 2026-11-15T12:00:22.518Z, 16 models, 1 retired record, 18 sources all status ok, alerts [].
entries.note: The Studio refreshes this at most once a day from Cloudflare, fal and models.dev without calling inference. Its own checkedAt is the authoritative freshness stamp.

entries.label: Eligibility on this Cloudflare account
entries.observed: One route is proven eligible on this account by a recorded generation: studio-craft on @cf/black-forest-labs/flux-2-klein-9b produced gen_4515ab469ca948dfbe5587bbf142c8ac, a 1024x1280 JPEG of 459,080 bytes with SHA-256 b32781d2…, status saved. The other Workers AI ids are catalogue-verified only, and the account model-search endpoint refused this machine's token with HTTP 403.
entries.note: A live catalogue page is not the same claim as a route that has actually produced output on this account. Both are shown separately so neither is mistaken for the other.

changes.note: Read from the provider's own price description today. It is the one real change since the previous check, and it changes a caveat rather than a number.

changes.note: The eight extra routes are real and runnable in the Studio. A reader who only saw Composer's snapshot would understate what the Studio can do.

publicModels() 16 records and publicRetiredModels() 1 record; file SHA-256 2d45ea17…6f4 at the deployed revision

Eleven keyword searches, one per fal endpoint: every one returned the exact id with status "public", deprecated false, removed false
Eight selectable models, one retired record, checkedAt 2026-11-15T12:00:22.518Z; identical to the live manifest on endpoint, kind, costMicro and retired record

limits: No generation ran for this inventory. Every row is a catalogue read, so a live route is not proof that a request would succeed, cost what the estimate says, or look right.
Planning costs are the Studio's own estimates. No provider invoice was read, and none is claimed.
The Studio manifest's own checkedAt is 2026-11-15T12:00:22.518Z. The per-model verification here is a separate read on 2026-11-16, so the two dates differ by design.

Only one Workers AI route in this inventory has an on-account generation receipt (studio-craft). The other Workers AI rows are catalogue-verified: the provider page resolves, which is not the same as a successful request on this account.
fal's published price description for h3-max-turbo is time-bounded prose. It changed meaning on 2026-11-16 and will change again.
A withdrawn id can disappear from fal search without a deprecation flag. Every endpoint is matched by exact id, and a missing exact match is recorded as drift rather than assumed.
